newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM considers extending trading time of metals.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM considers extending trading time of metals.

text.p: The Tokyo Commodity Exchange (TOCOM) said on Friday it would consider extending the trading time of precious metal and aluminium futures, in an attempt to provide more opportunities for arbitrage.

"This is part of our strategy to improve the Tokyo market's competitive edge," TOCOM spokesman Hiroshige Murata told reporters. He said the exchange would discuss extending the trading time this fiscal year.
He said the exchange mainly aims to provide arbitrage opportunities between the Tokyo and London metal markets.
